summary.en: Classify the polarization of one muFerro frame into the 26 cubic variants, draw one surface per variant with a legend, and report variant fractions and the energy trace. Label -1 is unclassified or air and 0 is substrate; both are excluded from the fraction denominator.
summary.zh_CN: 将一帧 muFerro 极化按 26 个立方变体分类，每个变体绘制一个表面并给出图例，同时报告变体占比与能量曲线。标签 -1 表示未分类或空气，0 表示衬底，两者都不计入占比分母。

purpose.en: Read frames, classify variants and count fractions.
purpose.zh_CN: 读取帧数据、分类变体并统计占比。

purpose.en: Extract and smooth the variant surfaces; fractions do not need it.
purpose.zh_CN: 提取并平滑变体表面；占比统计不需要。

purpose.en: The PNG image needs offscreen OpenGL (EGL or OSMesa).
purpose.zh_CN: PNG 图像需要离屏 OpenGL（EGL 或 OSMesa）。

title.en: Latest frame: 3D domains and variant fractions
title.zh_CN: 最新一帧：三维畴结构与变体占比
